text.international: Donald Trump and Silicon Valley figures, including Elon Musk, defend Nvidia chief Jensen Huang after he admits an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, and Trump says the FBI is looking into it. Republican Thomas Massie moves to force a vote to impeach defence secretary Pete Hegseth. At Cop31 in Turkey, UN climate chief Simon Stiell says high fossil fuel prices spread inflation, and witnesses in Gaza describe trying to save people buried in a landslide.
